_about: Historical and documentary: a real-feeling time and place, no magic, wounds that matter. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

era: a port city in the age of sail
a mill town in the early factory age
a frontier town before the railway
a monastery in a plague year
event: a new law that ruins the poor
texture: candles that cost a day's work
a doctor who is mostly guessing

cliches: a famous person appears to give advice
the evil aristocrat twirls his moustache
